notes.title: Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition - Update 1.2!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31133292/d5a3a4bb8623e3b02e35436b42b2912d2e6f9421.jpg[/img]

It's been a while but we at Cherry Kiss are still working on improving Wild Romance! This time around in update 1.2 we are happy to announce the following new features and changes to the game:

- Steam trading cards are finally active, after months of waiting we hit the magic number that activated the card dropping functionality, hopefully you all enjoy collecting the cards and crafting badges!
- We have overhauled the in-game sprites with higher resolution versions so that we can make them zoom in and out when the game wants to focus on the characters face or... other parts of the body.
- As we were working on enhancing the sprites we also changed the sprite animations, no more are the days of bouncing sprites! Today we have blinking and talking animations instead.
- I've also gone through while implementing the blinky-talky sprites and revamped the game so that multiple characters appear on screen when they are "talking to each other" instead of swapping between the appropriate sprite depending on who is talking.
- I read a review that suggested we add a textbox behind the dialogue that can have a customizable opacity and so I added that too! 

As always we appreciate your feedback and hope that everyone is enjoying Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition, feel free to reach out to us on our Twitter or consider joining the Cherry Kiss discord server!
